init_hook: echo 'Start dev server?  devbox run start'

scripts.db:push:local: env TURSO_DATABASE_URL="file:./local.db" TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN="" bash scripts/devbox-guard.sh && env TURSO_DATABASE_URL="file:./local.db" TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN="" bash scripts/devbox-pnpm.sh db:push
scripts.db:studio: env TURSO_DATABASE_URL="file:./local.db" TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN="" bash scripts/devbox-guard.sh && env TURSO_DATABASE_URL="file:./local.db" TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN="" bash scripts/devbox-pnpm.sh db:studio
